title: 常见故障排查判定器：端口占用/卷权限/网络不通/DNS 失败/时区编码（正反两组）
expected_output:
### 容器故障排查判定器 ###

=== 正例组：症状可命中规则库 ===
  s1   症状: Error starting userland proxy: listen tcp4 0.0.0.0:8080: bind: address already in use
       判定: [P1] 端口占用
       根因: 宿主端口已被另一个容器或宿主进程占用
       处置: ss -lntp 查占用者；改宿主侧端口映射 8081:8080；或停掉占用进程
       期望=P1 实际=P1 匹配=True

  s2   症状: docker: Error response from daemon: Bind for 0.0.0.0:80 failed: port is already allocated
       判定: [P1] 端口占用
       根因: 宿主端口已被另一个容器或宿主进程占用
       处置: ss -lntp 查占用者；改宿主侧端口映射 8081:8080；或停掉占用进程
       期望=P1 实际=P1 匹配=True

  s3   症状: open /data/app.log: permission denied
       判定: [P2] 卷权限
       根因: bind mount 的宿主目录属主与容器内 uid 不一致（非 root 运行时典型）
       处置: chown 到镜像 USER 的 uid；或改用命名卷让 docker 初始化属主；检查 :ro 是否误加
       期望=P2 实际=P2 匹配=True

  s4   症状: api | ConnectionError: HTTPConnectionPool(host='db', port=5432): connection refused
       判定: [P3] 网络不通
       根因: 容器端口未发布到宿主 / 目标服务没监听 / 不在同一自定义网络
       处置: 容器内 curl 自己的服务端口先自证；确认 ports 与容器内监听端口一致；确认两个服务加入同一个 network
       期望=P3 实际=P3 匹配=True

  s5   症状: dial tcp: lookup db on 127.0.0.11:53: no such host
       判定: [P4] DNS 解析失败
       根因: 用 localhost/127.0.0.1 互访（应为服务名）；或用了默认 bridge 网络（无内嵌 DNS）
       处置: 容器间互访一律用服务名；显式声明自定义 network；检查 network alias
       期望=P4 实际=P4 匹配=True

  s6   症状: 订单时间与本地相差 8 小时（timezone 未设置，容器内是 UTC）
       判定: [P5] 时区偏移
       根因: 镜像未装 tzdata 或未设 TZ，容器内是 UTC
       处置: ENV TZ=Asia/Shanghai；挂载 /etc/localtime；装 tzdata
       期望=P5 实际=P5 匹配=True

  s7   症状: UnicodeEncodeError: 'ascii' codec can't encode characters
       判定: [P6] 编码乱码
       根因: 容器 locale 为 POSIX/C，Python/Java 默认用 ASCII 或宿主编码读写
       处置: ENV LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8；Python 侧显式 encoding='utf-8'；-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8
       期望=P6 实际=P6 匹配=True


=== 反例组：症状未命中 / 易误判 ===
  n1   症状: OOMKilled: container was killed because of memory limit
       判定: 未知症状（规则库未覆盖）
       期望=P1 实际=None 匹配=False

  n2   症状: connection refused
       判定: [P3] 网络不通
       根因: 容器端口未发布到宿主 / 目标服务没监听 / 不在同一自定义网络
       处置: 容器内 curl 自己的服务端口先自证；确认 ports 与容器内监听端口一致；确认两个服务加入同一个 network
       期望=P4 实际=P3 匹配=False


=== 结论判据 ===
正例组 7 条症状全部正确归类: True（预期 True）
OOM 症状不会被误判成端口占用: True（预期 True）
connection refused 归为 P3 网络不通而非 P4 DNS: True（预期 True）

排查顺序建议：先看容器是否活着 -> 看退出码（137=OOM，143=SIGTERM）-> 
              看日志 -> 进容器自证端口 -> 再查宿主端口与网络。
code:
RULES = [
    {
        "id": "P1",
        "name": "端口占用",
        "keys": ["port is already allocated", "address already in use"],
        "cause": "宿主端口已被另一个容器或宿主进程占用",
        "fix": ["ss -lntp 查占用者", "改宿主侧端口映射 8081:8080", "或停掉占用进程"],
    },
    {
        "id": "P2",
        "name": "卷权限",
        "keys": ["permission denied", "read-only file system"],
        "cause": "bind mount 的宿主目录属主与容器内 uid 不一致（非 root 运行时典型）",
        "fix": ["chown 到镜像 USER 的 uid", "或改用命名卷让 docker 初始化属主", "检查 :ro 是否误加"],
    },
    {
        "id": "P3",
        "name": "网络不通",
        "keys": ["connection refused", "no route to host"],
        "cause": "容器端口未发布到宿主 / 目标服务没监听 / 不在同一自定义网络",
        "fix": ["容器内 curl 自己的服务端口先自证", "确认 ports 与容器内监听端口一致",
                "确认两个服务加入同一个 network"],
    },
    {
        "id": "P4",
        "name": "DNS 解析失败",
        "keys": ["no such host", "temporary failure in name resolution",
                 "name resolution failure"],
        "cause": "用 localhost/127.0.0.1 互访（应为服务名）；或用了默认 bridge 网络（无内嵌 DNS）",
        "fix": ["容器间互访一律用服务名", "显式声明自定义 network", "检查 network alias"],
    },
    {
        "id": "P5",
        "name": "时区偏移",
        "keys": ["utc offset", "timezone", "8 小时", "utc"],
        "cause": "镜像未装 tzdata 或未设 TZ，容器内是 UTC",
        "fix": ["ENV TZ=Asia/Shanghai", "挂载 /etc/localtime", "装 tzdata"],
    },
    {
        "id": "P6",
        "name": "编码乱码",
        "keys": ["unicodeencodeerror", "mojibake", "gbk"],
        "cause": "容器 locale 为 POSIX/C，Python/Java 默认用 ASCII 或宿主编码读写",
        "fix": ["ENV LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8", "Python 侧显式 encoding='utf-8'",
                "-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8"],
    },
]


def triage(log_line):
    low = log_line.lower()
    for r in RULES:
        for k in r["keys"]:
            if k in low:
                return r
    return None


def show(cid, log_line, expected_id=None):
    r = triage(log_line)
    print("  %-4s 症状: %s" % (cid, log_line))
    if r is None:
        print("       判定: 未知症状（规则库未覆盖）")
        hit = False
    else:
        print("       判定: [%s] %s" % (r["id"], r["name"]))
        print("       根因: %s" % r["cause"])
        print("       处置: %s" % "；".join(r["fix"]))
        hit = True
    if expected_id is not None:
        got = r["id"] if r else "None"
        print("       期望=%s 实际=%s 匹配=%s" % (expected_id, got, got == expected_id))
    print()
    return hit, (r["id"] if r else None)


print("### 容器故障排查判定器 ###")
print()
print("=== 正例组：症状可命中规则库 ===")
hits = []
for cid, line, exp in [
    ("s1", "Error starting userland proxy: listen tcp4 0.0.0.0:8080: bind: address already in use", "P1"),
    ("s2", "docker: Error response from daemon: Bind for 0.0.0.0:80 failed: port is already allocated", "P1"),
    ("s3", "open /data/app.log: permission denied", "P2"),
    ("s4", "api | ConnectionError: HTTPConnectionPool(host='db', port=5432): connection refused", "P3"),
    ("s5", "dial tcp: lookup db on 127.0.0.11:53: no such host", "P4"),
    ("s6", "订单时间与本地相差 8 小时（timezone 未设置，容器内是 UTC）", "P5"),
    ("s7", "UnicodeEncodeError: 'ascii' codec can't encode characters", "P6"),
]:
    hit, got = show(cid, line, exp)
    hits.append(got == exp)
print()
print("=== 反例组：症状未命中 / 易误判 ===")
n1_hit, n1_got = show("n1", "OOMKilled: container was killed because of memory limit", "P1")
n2_hit, n2_got = show("n2", "connection refused", "P4")
print()

print("=== 结论判据 ===")
print("正例组 7 条症状全部正确归类: %s（预期 True）" % all(hits))
print("OOM 症状不会被误判成端口占用: %s（预期 True）" % (n1_got != "P1"))
print("connection refused 归为 P3 网络不通而非 P4 DNS: %s（预期 True）" % (n2_got == "P3"))
print()
print("排查顺序建议：先看容器是否活着 -> 看退出码（137=OOM，143=SIGTERM）-> ")
print("              看日志 -> 进容器自证端口 -> 再查宿主端口与网络。")
